summary: Backend + light frontend testing for iter220: self-service 7-day edit/delete window on donations & expenses AND the new POST /api/accounting/seed-bulk auto-wire endpoint. All 18 targeted backend tests pass. Iter219 regression (11/11) still passes. Frontend FinancialPage admin view loads cleanly and Edit/Del buttons render for all rows as admin (46 donation edit + 46 del buttons visible; expense buttons will appear on the Expenses tab which uses the same canEditEntry gate).
critical_code_review_comments: financial.py: `_within_self_edit_window` accepts a future-dated created_at (negative age passes the < 7 check). Not exploitable in practice (created_at is server-set) but consider clamping to abs(age).

financial.py `update_expense`: JE re-post is guarded by `status == 'approved'`, matching the create-time posting rule. Good. Consider also short-circuiting when only non-financial fields (title/notes/receipt_url) change — currently updated_at/updated_by are always written even for no-op payloads (minor).
FinancialPage.jsx: `canEditEntry` mirrors backend logic but uses client clock. Acceptable since server re-checks. Edit dialog Save now calls updateExpense — verified via grep.

success_rate.frontend: smoke pass — admin route + row-level buttons visible

seed_data_creation: Two Staff users (test_iter220_a_*, test_iter220_b_*@example.com) created per test module run for self-service window tests. Left in DB with 'test_iter220_' prefix for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test lives at /app/tests/test_iter220_self_service_and_seed_bulk.py (moved OUT of /app/backend/tests to avoid backend --reload watch triggering during test import). Two gotchas: (1) auth/login lower-cases the identifier, so seeded emails MUST be all lowercase; (2) non-admin users need `finance_access: true` on the user doc to access /api/financial/*. Both are handled in the fixture. Login response key is `token` (not `access_token`).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial test failures were fixture bugs on my side (uppercase email + missing finance_access flag), not backend bugs.
